name: Ambarish S. Ghatpande, PhD
academic_profile: Biophysicist and neuroscientist with experience spanning ion channel biophysics, neuromodulation, sensory circuit physiology, and population-level neural dynamics.
Recent work focuses on large-scale extracellular recordings from human cortical and hippocampal organoids, in vitro and post-transplantation.
Developed end-to-end pipelines for silicon probe recordings, spike sorting (Kilosort4), and computational population analysis using open-source Python tools.
Early work on sodium and cyclic nucleotide–gated ion channels, followed by studies of cholinergic and nitric oxide signaling in olfactory bulb circuits.

academic_research.title: Senior Research Investigator
